description: Lists of public and private hospitals in Lebanon is a series of data sets listed in Open Data Lebanon, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Data Lebanon. In this excel sheet you can find a list of public hospitals in Lebanon. Coverage: Lebanon. The portal lists 2 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Open Data Lebanon. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support health-facility access and emergency-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odl-portal.
